title: An EmDash site's locate snapshot is read gently and a build past its limit is not thrown away
steps: S1: build a snapshot of five records with the EmDash read plan, a clock moving 40 per read.
S2: build with a 25 limit and 10 per read, then move one read record and build again.
expect: S1: never two reads at once; each read is followed by a pause of 40.
S2: the first build reads three and is not kept; the second reads only the moved one and the two never read, takes over two, and is kept.
evidence: Issue #252: "41 records in 128058 ms, not kept (incomplete)" while the site's home page took 5-17 s

tests: locateReads: both Claude Cowork plugins read in batches, one call at a time only on Joomla
snapshot: an EmDash-like site is read one record at a time, each read followed by a pause as long as it took (#252)
snapshot: a build past its limit keeps what it read whole; the next build reads only the rest (#252)
